Job requirements If you want to work as an Aircraft Maintenance Technician with us, we require the following from you: - Possession of B1.1 or B1.1/B2 Aircraft Maintenance License (AML) - Aircraft type training is an advantage - Knowledge of EASA laws and regulations - Experience within an aircraft maintenance environment - Good command of the English language in both written and spoken forms. What can you expect from us? - A base monthly salary of € 3,900 to € 5,250 - Irregularity allowance of approximately € 1,050 per month - Year-end bonus, annual profit sharing, annua...
